title: The Missing Maple Bow
scene: At 9:40 AM, the prized maple violin bow vanished from the stage. Only the dean saw the snapped purple silk tassel left on the stand.

suspects.name: Benson Gray
suspects.testimony: I graded scores in the office from 9:20 to 9:45 AM—I never touched any bow with a purple silk tassel!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned the purple silk tassel, and rosin dust coated Benson's jacket sleeve.

suspects.name: Soren Lind
suspects.testimony: I brewed coffee in the lounge from 9:20 to 9:40 AM before walking onstage and finding the empty case.
suspects.alibiProof: Two cellists chatted with Soren in the lounge from 9:20 to 9:40 AM while he poured coffee.

suspects.name: Margot Blythe
suspects.testimony: I tuned my violin in the wings right beside the stage from 9:25 to 9:45 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: The stagehand watched Margot tuning her violin in the wings from 9:25 to 9:45 AM.

suspects.name: Naomi Flores
suspects.testimony: I practiced scales in Room 4 from 9:20 to 9:45 AM and never stepped near the auditorium.
suspects.alibiProof: The hall monitor heard Naomi practicing scales in Room 4 continuously from 9:20 to 9:45 AM.
